TestCDCBatchesSimple::test_delta_batch_o.description: CDC with delta only (no images): logged batches inserting/updating all, even, odd columns, nulling, and re-updating 5 partitions x 3 rows x 10 cols of one of 11 types; asserts per-partition CDC group count, row count (no image rows) and delta values.

origin.summary: feature(cdc_batch): Tests for cdc feature behavior with batches (Aleksandr Bykov); covers scylladb/scylla ee7291a (full preimage) and 9042161 (better pre/postimages for complicated batches). Function history stops at 5d26fdbe (pytest port).

TestCDCBatchesSimple::test_delta_batch_o.relevance: CDC preimage modes on/full/off and postimage are live: cdc/log.cc:425-460 (options parsing, values lowercased), cdc/cdc_options.hh image_mode. Logged multi-partition batches (5 pk x 3 ck x 10 cols) of INSERT/UPDATE incl. null updates. Runs in next gating (both tablets and consistent-topology stages), 100% pass, ~5-13s per param x 11 types.

TestCDCBatchesSimple::test_delta_batch_o.reason: Unique type-matrix coverage of delta-only CDC log for logged multi-partition batches; boost test_batch_images covers images only. (affects this test: no postimage).
